title: CTG-FRAME: development and validation of a multi‑modal deep learning for intrapartum escalation support and severe fetal acidemia prediction.
summary: The multimodal CTG-FRAME model used fetal heart-rate and contraction signals to predict severe umbilical-artery acidemia and flag cases for human review. Development and a separate multicenter external cohort were evaluated; the model is not an autonomous-care system.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: Three-fold development used 552 cases; a separate multicenter SPaM cohort included 300. Internal AUROC was 0.888 at the prespecified threshold; external calibration was evaluated without retuning.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective cohort testing does not establish prospective workflow benefit; intended role is to escalate human review, not autonomous care.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
